spec.name: Floor
spec.role: floor plate under the car with rear diffuser ramp
spec.notes: Thin flat plate X -4300 to -400, Y ±800, Z 0-30; top face Z=30 carries the monocoque. Simplified side edges: chamfered/tapered outer edges and slightly tapered front corners in plan. Rear diffuser ramp: wedge X -3700 to -4300, Y ±500, rising from Z=30 at X=-3700 to Z=230 at rear edge, behind the monocoque rear face so no intersection. Single solid body.

script_body:
import math
import adsk.core
import adsk.fusion


def build(part):
    L = part.p["length"]
    W = part.p["width"]
    T = part.p["thickness"]
    DL = part.p["diffuser_length"]
    DH = part.p["diffuser_exit_height"]
    D1 = part.p.get("rear_taper_start", 2000.0)
    D2 = part.p.get("rear_taper_end", 2630.0)
    RHW = part.p.get("rear_half_width", 520.0)
    R = part.p.get("front_corner_radius", 250.0)
    FR = part.p.get("edge_fillet", 8.0)
    xf = -400.0
    xr = xf - L
    hw = W / 2
    # Smooth plan outline: rounded front corners, tangent double-arc S-curve taper
    sk = part.sketch(part.plane("z", 0), "SK_floor_outline")
    lines = sk.sketchCurves.sketchLines
    arcs = sk.sketchCurves.sketchArcs

    def P(x, y):
        return sk.modelToSketchSpace(pt(x, y, 0))

    def arc_pt(cx, cy, r, a):
        return (cx + r * math.cos(a), cy + r * math.sin(a))

    xa = xf - D1
    xb = xf - D2
    dx = (D2 - D1) / 2
    dy = (hw - RHW) / 2
    rs = (dx * dx + dy * dy) / (2 * dy)
    mx, my = xa - dx, hw - dy
    c1 = (xa, hw - rs)
    a1e = math.atan2(my - c1[1], mx - c1[0])
    m1 = arc_pt(c1[0], c1[1], rs, (math.pi / 2 + a1e) / 2)
    c2 = (xb, RHW + rs)
    a2s = math.atan2(my - c2[1], mx - c2[0])
    m2 = arc_pt(c2[0], c2[1], rs, (a2s - math.pi / 2) / 2)
    mc = arc_pt(xf - R, hw - R, R, math.pi / 4)
    for s in (1, -1):
        arcs.addByThreePoints(P(xf, s * (hw - R)), P(mc[0], s * mc[1]), P(xf - R, s * hw))
        lines.addByTwoPoints(P(xf - R, s * hw), P(xa, s * hw))
        arcs.addByThreePoints(P(xa, s * hw), P(m1[0], s * m1[1]), P(mx, s * my))
        arcs.addByThreePoints(P(mx, s * my), P(m2[0], s * m2[1]), P(xb, s * RHW))
        lines.addByTwoPoints(P(xb, s * RHW), P(xr, s * RHW))
    lines.addByTwoPoints(P(xf, -(hw - R)), P(xf, hw - R))
    lines.addByTwoPoints(P(xr, -RHW), P(xr, RHW))
    part.extrude(part.profile(sk), "thickness", "EX_floor_plate")
    # Consistent rounded top edge along the whole outline
    body = part.body(0)
    top = None
    best = 0.0
    for f in body.faces:
        bb = f.boundingBox
        if bb.minPoint.z > mm(T) - 0.001 and f.area > best:
            best = f.area
            top = f
    edges = adsk.core.ObjectCollection.create()
    for e in top.edges:
        edges.add(e)
    fillets = part.comp.features.filletFeatures
    finp = fillets.createInput()
    finp.edgeSetInputs.addConstantRadiusEdgeSet(edges, val(FR), True)
    fil = fillets.add(finp)
    fil.name = "FIL_top_edge"
    # Rear diffuser ramp wedge
    xd = xr + DL
    skd = part.sketch(part.plane("y", 0), "SK_diffuser")
    part.polygon(skd, [(xd, 0, T - 10), (xr, 0, T - 10), (xr, 0, DH), (xd, 0, T)])
    part.extrude(part.profile(skd), "diffuser_width", "EX_diffuser", op="join", symmetric=True)

Keep the top face at Z=30, the bottom at Z=0, the diffuser ramp over the last 600 mm and its 1000 mm width, and the flat contact with the monocoque underside. Change nothing else.

history.summary: Plan outline rebuilt with R250 front corners and a tangent double-arc S-curve taper; 8 mm top-edge fillet replaces chamfer; lip skipped
history.instruction:
Soften the floor outline and edges. Use the current registered version as the base. Keep exactly as is: top face Z=30, bottom Z=0, the X range, the narrowed rear section, the diffuser ramp, the flat contact with the monocoque underside, and at least 20 mm clearance from the rear wheels. One connected solid.
Change only: (1) plan outline: replace straight lines and corners with smooth curves: rounded front corners (radius about 250 mm) and one continuous S-curve for the taper from the wide section to the rear half-width, no kinks; (2) a consistent rounded top edge of about 8 mm along the whole outline, including the tapered and rear sections; (3) optional, only if robust: a low continuous lip along the outer edge of the front half (about 10 mm thick, 25 mm tall) fading out at the taper. Skip the lip if it creates thin or unreliable geometry.

revision.change_summary: Plan outline rebuilt with R250 front corners and a tangent double-arc S-curve taper; 8 mm top-edge fillet replaces chamfer; lip skipped
assumptions: The S-curve uses two tangent arcs (radius about 424 mm) between X=-2400/Y=800 and X=-3030/Y=520. It lies inside the old linear taper near the rear wheels, so wheel clearance can only increase.
The 8 mm fillet replaces the 20 mm chamfer on the top outer edges and runs around the whole outline, including the rear edge. edge_chamfer is no longer used.
The optional 10x25 mm lip was skipped because a fade-out lip combined with the fillet risks thin or unreliable geometry.
At X=-2950 the floor is about 28 mm narrower than the old linear taper. Sidepod contact still relies on the flat top face at Z=30.
